clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge's Library, the Explorers' League keeps its histories and recovered relics. The eastern wing of the Hall of Explorers holds books and artifacts gathered from across Azeroth.

Dwarven scholars study relics and field reports from across the world in a great chamber of the Hall of Explorers. The Explorers' League keeps the Library, where shelves hold chronicles of the War of the Three Hammers, the ancient Troll Wars, and the origins of the dwarven race. Librarian Mae Paledust helps visitors find rare books and records.

Curator Thorius oversees the Library's displays of physical finds from deep excavations, abandoned ruins, and distant shorelines. League members study, preserve, and display these objects. The collection ranges from crude murloc idols and carved knives to relics recovered frozen in northern ice. Curators record each find as they piece together the history of the Titans and early Azeroth.
